why: B delivers every piece in the right form: a dark-wood desk that fits in front of the window, a truly low bookcase, a proper lounge-style leather reading chair and a crisp black lamp, all in a cohesive modern palette (only the bookcase's light top is off). A's curved bookcase is tall, decorative and shallow rather than a low library, and its upright reception armchair with reddish mahogany legs is less suited to reading and clashes with the walnut desk.
